about: Habit Nudges' own helpers (its main.js internals, loaded by tools/golden-nudges.mjs with the app stubbed) on made-up inputs, in a fixed UTC-5 zone. Regenerate when main.js changes.

stand.name: idle past the active window: those minutes do not count
the Mac slept: a long gap resets
a gap longer than two ticks counts as two
a call holds the count and takes a due card down
snoozed: due only once the snooze ends
standing through a call still counts

desk.name: opens on the first input, then follows the last one
five quiet minutes end it at the last input
back after an unseen break starts a new one
crossing local midnight splits it there
stopped (a timer by hand, or standing): closes
